cues: The brain, about one point three five kilograms, floating in cerebrospinal fluid inside three meninges.
The cerebrum thinks, remembers and moves you.
The hypothalamus controls temperature, hunger and thirst, and the pituitary.

text: The brain, about one point three five kilograms, floating in cerebrospinal fluid inside three meninges. The cerebrum thinks, remembers and moves you. The thalamus relays the senses. The hypothalamus controls temperature, hunger and thirst, and the pituitary. The cerebellum keeps balance. And the medulla runs the vital centres: heartbeat, breathing and blood pressure.
